description:
See the screen; call it on your top picks before writing UI. preview (default) is 1x, so
1 image px = 1 CSS px (the top of a long page). The text gives its pixel size and a long
page's sections: section=N returns one as a 1x crop. size=full is the original (often 2x),
refused above 8000 px tall.

screenId.description: Screen id from search_screens or get_product, e.g. linear-signup.

section.description: One section of a long page, by number or title words, as a 1x crop.

name: get_screen_image
title: Get a screen's screenshot
